title: Safety Data Sheet - Solvent Wash 40
key_sentences: This sheet follows the 16-section format required for chemical products supplied to professional users.
Read it fully before handling the product.
Vapours are heavier than air and may travel to a source of ignition and flash back.
Cool closed containers exposed to fire with water spray.
The information relates only to the product named above and not to its use with other materials.

rows: Cleaning of metal parts before coating

list_items.text: Specific target organ toxicity, single exposure, category 3
- Eye contact: rinse with plenty of water for at least 15 minutes and seek medical advice.
- Skin contact: remove contaminated clothing and wash the skin with soap and water.
- Inhalation: move the person into fresh air and keep them at rest.
- Ingestion: rinse the mouth and do not induce vomiting.
2) Carbon dioxide or dry powder for small fires.
3) Water spray for cooling containers only.
